title: Implement the LRU cache
task: Finish LruCache<K, V> in src/lib.rs (K: Eq + Hash + Clone; V has no bounds) without adding dependencies. Keep new, capacity, len and is_empty. Implement get and put, and add peek, remove and keys. Recency: get of a present key and put of any key make that key the most recently used; peek, remove, keys, len and failed lookups do not change recency. get(&mut self, key: &K) -> Option<&V> returns the stored value. put(&mut self, key: K, value: V) -> Option<V>: if key is present, replace its value and return the old one, never evicting; otherwise, if len == capacity, first remove the least recently used entry, then insert and return None. A cache of capacity 0 never stores anything: put returns None and len stays 0. peek(&self, key: &K) -> Option<&V> reads without touching recency. remove(&mut self, key: &K) -> Option<V> deletes the entry and returns its value. keys(&self) -> Vec<K> returns the keys from most to least recently used. Replace the todo!() bodies and add unit tests for eviction order.
